status: frozen before any rating or outcome was computed
asked_by: Madhav, 25 Oct 2026: "We can add both, if they are helping Ananta in either crypto and Indian infrastructure ... see where hugging face fits for us"
title: Does a financial-news model's reading of NSE company announcements predict the stock's drift over the next 5 and 20 sessions, beyond the announcement's category?

model.source: Hugging Face, downloaded 25 Oct 2026, run locally on the Mac (no fitting, no fine-tuning: zero-shot)
model.input: the announcement's text field (silver/pr/announcements.parquet column text: subject plus body as the PR zip gives it), first 128 tokens
model.output: p_positive, p_negative, p_neutral; label = the largest; tone = p_positive - p_negative
model.second_model: none (yiyanghkust/finbert-tone was considered and NOT registered, so it is not run)

data.announcements: silver/pr/announcements.parquet, 2010-01-04 to 2023-12-29 only (research never reads 2024+ or the sealed folders; india/leakcheck.py)
data.categories: every category except nav and share_cert (fund NAVs and share-certificate notices are not company news); the V02 categories are kept as the control
data.universe: a stock-day with a row in gold/features/daily.parquet that day (the lab's 500 most liquid), as V02
data.prices: gold/bars/adj_daily close; Nifty 50 from silver/kite_index day
data.counts_before_rating: 319,430 announcements on 234,386 stock-days, 249,893 distinct texts (counts only, no outcome read)

timing: the file of day d is known after the close of d (as V02): the outcome runs from the close of d to the close of d+5 and d+20 (session counts on the trading calendar of the adjusted bars), minus Nifty over the same sessions; |drift| above 100% dropped (as V02). The same-day move is never counted

aggregation.stock_day_tone: the mean tone of that stock's announcements that day
aggregation.stock_day_label: positive = at least one positive and no negative announcement; negative = at least one negative and no positive; mixed = both; neutral = all neutral

pos|drift5.what: mean drift5 of positive stock-days (quarter means, t over quarters)

spread|drift5.what: per quarter: mean drift5 of positive minus negative stock-days

spread|drift20.what: per quarter: mean drift20 of positive minus negative stock-days

within_cat|drift20.what: per quarter: inside each category, mean drift20 of positive minus negative stock-days, averaged over the categories that have both (beyond the category)

rank|drift20.what: per quarter: Spearman rank correlation between stock-day tone and drift20 across that quarter's stock-days

statistics: quarter blocks (calendar quarter of day d), t over quarter means; dev 2010-2017, validation 2018-2023; at least 16 quarters per period (registry MIN_DATES)

bar.why: 24 distinct events-family rows on 25 Oct (V01-V03, whose announcement categories this study builds on) plus these 8 = 32, frozen; two-sided Bonferroni z = 3.16
bar.rule: registry standard rule: VALIDATED needs |t| >= z in both periods with the same sign as expected; CONDITIONAL z in one and 1.65 in the other

what_a_pass_means: the reading carries information about the next weeks. It is NOT a trade: the drifts are gross of costs (a round trip costs about 0.3-0.5% at Rs 12,000-50,000); a paper rule would need its own registered test and Madhav's yes
forward: from the session of 26 Oct 2026 every evening's announcement file (bronze/announce_api, the same file the reconstruction card reads) is rated and stored in paper/news_read/<day>.json; the reconstruction card shows the counts as a note; nothing trades on it; after 20 forward sessions the same variants are read on the forward rows (descriptive)
